verdict.recommendedAction: Move msg-416639 (partition 10, offset 776449) to a dead-letter queue or skip past it so partition 10 can drain. Set max-retries plus DLQ routing on the index-worker consumer. Look into why the producer emitted a payload with a NUL byte, then replay the affected product updates once fixed.
